text:
sara_sales: Quick heads-up — Horizon Health wants to run a POC with NeuroSuite (7B). They're asking about: model variants we can serve, latency SLO p95 ~50ms, SOC2/HSM for keys, and committed capacity pricing. Can eng/runtime confirm compatibility and a pricing delta?

anya_se: tagging runtime/infra — @devon_sre @lee_prod — do we have NeuroSuite variants in catalog that support KV/prefix cache and the usual batching tricks? Also any known quirks for seq len ~512?

devon_sre: We have adapters for NeuroSuite but not all variants validated. KV cache works but needs the adapter that wires the model's kv-format to our cache keys. 50ms p95 is tight on hosted for 512 tokens; for p95=50ms I'd expect Dedicated (A100x2 or faster) + aggressive batching and prefix cache warmup. What RPS/throughput do they expect?

sara_sales: They said bursty interactive traffic, target steady 800 RPS with spikes to 1.2k. Mostly few-shot prompts, avg output ~40 tokens.

lee_prod: We already built two catalog variants: neurosuite-7b-q4f16 and neurosuite-7b-int8-llm. Neither has a formal compatibility badge for prefix caching. I'll kick off a catalog validation job today.

sara_sales: If helpful, here's the suggested model pinning we'd give them for a canary first deploy:
```yaml
model_pin:
  name: neurosuite-7b-q4f16
  rollout: canary
  autoscale:
    min: 2
    max: 8
    cpu_padding: 0.2
```

anya_se: Perfect — once lee's validation finishes, we can recommend a canary + fallback to neurosuite-7b-int8-llm for cost-sensitive traffic. Also: will prefix/KV cache survive restarts for Private? Customer asks about cold-starts.

devon_sre: For Private with persistent node pools and warmed KV cache the cold-start window is ~5s. If they run on Dedicated with warm standby it's <1s. We'll document the warmup procedure.

security_bot: Note: Horizon submitted a security questionnaire (v3). Required items: SOC2 report, customer-managed KMS/HSM, SSO (SAML), audit logs retention 1 year. Dev/security to confirm. Link: https://redwood.internal/security/attestations/neurosuite

anya_se: @security_bot thanks — @devon_sre can you confirm we can support customer-managed HSM + on-prem key storage for a Private deployment? Also any blockers around data egress for PHI?

devon_sre: Yes — Private supports customer KMS/HSM integrations (Vault/HSM via KMIP or cloud KMS). For PHI we recommend on-prem Private or a dedicated VPC with strict egress rules. We'll need the legal DPIA for data flows.

sara_sales: Pricing note from customer: they want committed reserved capacity quote and a comparison vs pay-as-you-go. Sales needs a ballpark delta between q4f16 vs int8 variant to prepare a proposal.

lee_prod: Preliminary cost guidance (very rough): neurosuite-7b-q4f16 ~0.75x cost of fp16; neurosuite-7b-int8-llm ~0.6x fp16. For Dedicated reserved pricing, multiply runtime unit price by commit factor; I'll send a spreadsheet after the validation run. :thumbsup:

anya_se: Great — once validation completes I'll assemble the POC runbook: endpoints, expected SLOs, rollout plan, validation checklist (latency, quality, regressions vs baseline), and security signoffs. Anyone want to add checks?

devon_sre: Add: KV cache hit-rate tracking, per-route token costing, and a fallback policy to int8 variant on overload. Also add an eval prompt set for their top-10 flows.

sara_sales: Thanks all — can we target an internal sync tomorrow 10:30am PT? I'll invite Horizon to a follow-up after we have catalog results.

lee_prod: Works for me. I'll post the validation job output in this thread when ready.

anya_se: +1. I'll draft the POC runbook and attach security answers.

sara_sales: Awesome, appreciate it.

lee_prod: (after run) validation started — initial compatibility note: kv schema mismatch on streaming tokens for int8 path, working on a shim. ETA 8 hours.

devon_sre: Noted. If shim is tricky we can route streaming requests to q4f16 while background converts cache entries.

sara_sales: Perfect, keep me posted.
